entries.title: Egyptian president Abdel Fattah El-Sisi states that Egypt will take all necessary steps to protect and defend…
entries.snippet: Egyptian president Abdel Fattah El-Sisi states that Egypt will take all necessary steps to protect and defend Saudi Arabia should the latter so desire.

entries.title: Masked Israeli settlers attack a group of European diplomats, including the Belgian consul general, French…
entries.snippet: Masked Israeli settlers attack a group of European diplomats, including the Belgian consul general, French and Polish diplomats, and Catholic representatives visiting Taybeh in the occupied West Bank, Palestine.

entries.title: The Houthis claim to have shot down a Royal Saudi Air Force Eurofighter Typhoon aircraft over Saada…
entries.snippet: The Houthis claim to have shot down a Royal Saudi Air Force Eurofighter Typhoon aircraft over Saada Governorate, Yemen. Saudi authorities did not comment on the claim.

entries.title: The Saudi Civil Defense reports that debris from intercepted Houthi cruise missiles injured four people,…
entries.snippet: The Saudi Civil Defense reports that debris from intercepted Houthi cruise missiles injured four people, including a child, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and damaged 15 homes.

entries.title: Two cargo ships, the Singapore-flagged container ship GFS Pride and the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged dry bulk…
entries.snippet: Two cargo ships, the Singapore-flagged container ship GFS Pride and the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged dry bulk carrier Cape Dao, sink after both are attacked by projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz while trying to navigate through what Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps called an "illegal and dangerous route." At least one crew member is killed in the attacks.

entries.title: A Russian ballistic missile attack strikes a power station in the Dniprovskyi District, Kyiv, Ukraine,…
entries.snippet: A Russian ballistic missile attack strikes a power station in the Dniprovskyi District, Kyiv, Ukraine, leaving more than 1,000 residential buildings without heating.

entries.title: The Ukrainian citizen accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines in 2022 faces trial at the Higher…
entries.snippet: The Ukrainian citizen accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines in 2022 faces trial at the Higher Regional Court in Hamburg, Germany,

entries.title: Two merchant ships are hit by unknown drones off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, with one sinking
entries.snippet: Two merchant ships are hit by unknown drones off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, with one sinking. Eleven crew members are missing and 20 in total are rescued. Bulgarian prime minister Rumen Radev has blamed Russia and summoned its ambassador. It is the second such attack in six days.

entries.title: At least 20 people are killed and 32 others are injured in a Russian glide bomb airstrike on a five-story…
entries.snippet: At least 20 people are killed and 32 others are injured in a Russian glide bomb airstrike on a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.

entries.title: Russian forces launch a ballistic missile attack on two buses in the city of Kramatorsk in Ukraine, killing…
entries.snippet: Russian forces launch a ballistic missile attack on two buses in the city of Kramatorsk in Ukraine, killing at least 30 people, while 18 others are wounded.

entries.title: Over 500,000 people take part in protests across France, according to the national trade union confederation,…
entries.snippet: Over 500,000 people take part in protests across France, according to the national trade union confederation, while clashes and riots erupt in large cities.

entries.title: Protesters force their way into Marseille's town hall and vandalize the interior before being dispersed
entries.snippet: Protesters force their way into Marseille's town hall and vandalize the interior before being dispersed.

entries.title: In Lille, protesters storm the city hall and damage the premises prior to being removed by security forces
entries.snippet: In Lille, protesters storm the city hall and damage the premises prior to being removed by security forces.

entries.title: Dozens of shops are looted across major French cities amid widespread rioting and civil unrest
entries.snippet: Dozens of shops are looted across major French cities amid widespread rioting and civil unrest.

entries.title: The Hôtel de Ville in Limoges were partially destroyed by fire
entries.snippet: The Hôtel de Ville in Limoges were partially destroyed by fire.

entries.title: Six deaths are confirmed in Florida, United States, from Hurricane Isaias
entries.snippet: Six deaths are confirmed in Florida, United States, from Hurricane Isaias.

entries.title: The National Hurricane Center reports that Hurricane Isaias has weakened to a post-tropical cyclone after…
entries.snippet: The National Hurricane Center reports that Hurricane Isaias has weakened to a post-tropical cyclone after making landfall near Destin, Florida, United States.

entries.title: Four people are killed during Isaias' landfall in the United States, with two deaths in Escambia County,…
entries.snippet: Four people are killed during Isaias' landfall in the United States, with two deaths in Escambia County, Florida, and another two in Alabama.

entries.title: In the United States, Georgia governor Brian Kemp declares a state of emergency ahead of Hurricane Isaias
entries.snippet: In the United States, Georgia governor Brian Kemp declares a state of emergency ahead of Hurricane Isaias.

entries.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens into a category 2 Atlantic hurricane
entries.snippet: Hurricane Isaias strengthens into a category 2 Atlantic hurricane.

entries.title: A missile attack by the Houthis kills 58 soldiers and injure over 200 at a training center in Shabwah…
entries.snippet: A missile attack by the Houthis kills 58 soldiers and injure over 200 at a training center in Shabwah Governorate, Yemen. There are 14 missing.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia says that it has intercepted a missile intended for Medina
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia says that it has intercepted a missile intended for Medina. However, the Houthis denied launching a missile at the city.

entries.title: The Houthis launch missiles against Al-Maashiq Palace, headquarters of the Presidential Leadership Council…
entries.snippet: The Houthis launch missiles against Al-Maashiq Palace, headquarters of the Presidential Leadership Council and official residence of President Rashad al-Alimi, in Aden, Yemen, killing five people and injuring 16. No member of the council is harmed in the attack.

entries.title: The Houthis claim to have attacked King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a…
entries.snippet: The Houthis claim to have attacked King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a ballistic missile for a third consecutive day.

entries.title: Delta Air Lines postpones direct flights from Atlanta's Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport to…
entries.snippet: Delta Air Lines postpones direct flights from Atlanta's Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport to Riyadh following attacks by the Houthis on the country.

entries.title: Three children are killed in an alleged Rapid Support Forces drone strike in Khartoum, Sudan
entries.snippet: Three children are killed in an alleged Rapid Support Forces drone strike in Khartoum, Sudan.

entries.title: Thirty people are killed and 47 people are injured in a drone strike on a cattle market in Nyala, South…
entries.snippet: Thirty people are killed and 47 people are injured in a drone strike on a cattle market in Nyala, South Darfur, Sudan.

entries.title: The Sudanese Armed Forces announces that they have re-captured the Bir Kelekel area of West Darfur, Sudan,…
entries.snippet: The Sudanese Armed Forces announces that they have re-captured the Bir Kelekel area of West Darfur, Sudan, from Rapid Support Forces, according to West Darfur state governor Bahr al-Din Adam Karama.

entries.title: Airstrikes are launched at the Egypt–Sudan border targeting an artisanal gold mine in a mountainous area,…
entries.snippet: Airstrikes are launched at the Egypt–Sudan border targeting an artisanal gold mine in a mountainous area, killing at least 72 people.

entries.title: An RSF drone strike in Blue Nile State, Sudan, kills 41 displaced people
entries.snippet: An RSF drone strike in Blue Nile State, Sudan, kills 41 displaced people.

entries.title: Kenya confirms four additional cases of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including three health workers who treated…
entries.snippet: Kenya confirms four additional cases of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including three health workers who treated Kenya's first patient and one of his relatives, raising the national total to seven. All four are already in quarantine.

entries.title: The Kenyan health ministry reports that no Ebola cases have been reported since one patient died from the…
entries.snippet: The Kenyan health ministry reports that no Ebola cases have been reported since one patient died from the disease on October 5, with 293 tests conducted.

entries.title: Kenya confirms its first imported case of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebolavirus in Nairobi in a deceased…
entries.snippet: Kenya confirms its first imported case of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebolavirus in Nairobi in a deceased male who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

entries.title: The Nairobi Hospital steps up its infection-control measures, tracing, and staff monitoring following Kenya's…
entries.snippet: The Nairobi Hospital steps up its infection-control measures, tracing, and staff monitoring following Kenya's first imported case of Ebola.

entries.title: Isaias strengthens into a category 3 Atlantic hurricane
entries.snippet: Isaias strengthens into a category 3 Atlantic hurricane. It would later weaken to category 2, with 365,000 people in Alabama and Florida, United States, reported to be without power ahead of its landfall.

entries.title: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida, and weakens to a category 1 hurricane
entries.snippet: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida, and weakens to a category 1 hurricane.

entries.title: Flooding is reported in areas of Southern California, U.S., including Long Beach and Newport Beach, and the…
entries.snippet: Flooding is reported in areas of Southern California, U.S., including Long Beach and Newport Beach, and the National Hurricane Center issues a tropical storm warning for the area. The warning is the first issued for San Diego County, California, since 2023 during Hurricane Hilary.

entries.title: Simon strengthens into a category 2 Pacific hurricane
entries.snippet: Simon strengthens into a category 2 Pacific hurricane.

entries.title: A woman carries out a mass stabbing at an adult school in Warsaw, Poland, injuring three people
entries.snippet: A woman carries out a mass stabbing at an adult school in Warsaw, Poland, injuring three people. The suspect is arrested. It is the third such attack in the country in a week.

entries.title: A 15-year-old student carries out a mass stabbing against staff members at a primary school in the village of…
entries.snippet: A 15-year-old student carries out a mass stabbing against staff members at a primary school in the village of Leszczydół-Nowiny, Wyszków County, Poland, killing one person and injuring two more. The suspect is taken into police custody.

entries.title: Nine people are injured in a mass stabbing at a high school in Ostrołęka, Poland
entries.snippet: Nine people are injured in a mass stabbing at a high school in Ostrołęka, Poland. The suspect, a 19-year-old student, is arrested after being injured himself.

entries.title: Israel Police arrest 10 people in the occupied West Bank over attacks on American photojournalist Heidi…
entries.snippet: Israel Police arrest 10 people in the occupied West Bank over attacks on American photojournalist Heidi Levine and the mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries, France, who were travelling with European diplomats, and seize vehicles and other evidence during raids.

entries.title: Israeli settlers attack and beat a group of Palestinians and an American journalist from The Washington Post
entries.snippet: Israeli settlers attack and beat a group of Palestinians and an American journalist from The Washington Post.

entries.title: Albertans vote on ten referendums, including one to decide if Alberta should seek separation from Canada
entries.snippet: Albertans vote on ten referendums, including one to decide if Alberta should seek separation from Canada.

entries.title: Albertan voters reject pursuing a future independence referendum, with more than two-thirds supporting the…
entries.snippet: Albertan voters reject pursuing a future independence referendum, with more than two-thirds supporting the province remaining in Canada.

entries.title: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reports that an oil tanker has caught on fire and exploded in the…
entries.snippet: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reports that an oil tanker has caught on fire and exploded in the southern part of the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine.

entries.title: The Pentagon raises the U.S
entries.snippet: The Pentagon raises the U.S. military death toll in the Iran war to 21 after reporting two noncombat deaths.

entries.title: In Czechia, opposition parties win 22 of the contested 27 seats in the Senate
entries.snippet: In Czechia, opposition parties win 22 of the contested 27 seats in the Senate. The lead party of prime minister Andrej Babiš's government, ANO 2011, comes in third place. The election is the first time in the country's history where governing parties did not win a single seat in a senatorial election.

entries.title: Czechs begin voting in the second round to elect 22 senators who were not elected in the first round
entries.snippet: Czechs begin voting in the second round to elect 22 senators who were not elected in the first round.

entries.title: Cockroach Janta Party leader Abhijeet Dipke is detained in Delhi, India, ahead of the party's planned march
entries.snippet: Cockroach Janta Party leader Abhijeet Dipke is detained in Delhi, India, ahead of the party's planned march.

entries.title: An executive magistrate's court in New Delhi, India, orders the release of Cockroach Janta Party founder…
entries.snippet: An executive magistrate's court in New Delhi, India, orders the release of Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and two other leaders, requiring them to avoid breaches of the peace for one year after their detention.

entries.title: Four people are killed fighting wildfires in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, Indonesia,…
entries.snippet: Four people are killed fighting wildfires in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, Indonesia, after flames and thick smoke trapped them. Two others suffer serious burns.

entries.title: The Indonesian forestry ministry and International Animal Rescue release eight orangutans rescued from…
entries.snippet: The Indonesian forestry ministry and International Animal Rescue release eight orangutans rescued from wildfires into a protected wildforest in West Kalimantan after fires destroyed habitat near plantations.

entries.title: Singapore records its highest air pollution level of 2026 as one-hour PM2.5 concentrations reach about 288…
entries.snippet: Singapore records its highest air pollution level of 2026 as one-hour PM2.5 concentrations reach about 288 micrograms per cubic metre amid haze from Indonesian wildfires.

entries.title: Timor-Leste suspends in-person classes nationwide from October 15 to 17 due to worsening air quality from…
entries.snippet: Timor-Leste suspends in-person classes nationwide from October 15 to 17 due to worsening air quality from wildfire smoke and pollutant particles across Southeast Asia.

entries.title: American economists Robert Ernest Hall and Michael Dean Woodford are jointly awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize…
entries.snippet: American economists Robert Ernest Hall and Michael Dean Woodford are jointly awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for their work on "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation".

entries.title: French chemist Henri B
entries.snippet: French chemist Henri B. Kagan from the Paris-Saclay University and Japanese organic chemist Kensō Soai from the Tokyo University of Science are jointly awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for "the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis".

entries.title: Two deaths are reported after hurricanes Rachel and Simon made landfall on Mexico's coast, with Guerrero…
entries.snippet: Two deaths are reported after hurricanes Rachel and Simon made landfall on Mexico's coast, with Guerrero governor Evelyn Salgado and Baja California governor Marina del Pilar Ávila confirming their deaths.

entries.title: Tropical storm Simon strengthens into a category 4 Pacific hurricane with 150 mph (240 kph) winds as it heads…
entries.snippet: Tropical storm Simon strengthens into a category 4 Pacific hurricane with 150 mph (240 kph) winds as it heads towards Mexico's coast.

entries.title: Pakistan's federal government detains hundreds of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) members, including former…
entries.snippet: Pakistan's federal government detains hundreds of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) members, including former Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister Sohail Afridi and other provincial officials, after suspending the PTI-led provincial administration and imposing emergency rule.

entries.title: Pakistani president Asif Ali Zardari declares a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and suspends its…
entries.snippet: Pakistani president Asif Ali Zardari declares a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and suspends its provincial government amid disputes over the province's response to Islamist militancy.

entries.title: Three civilians and two police officers are killed in a mass shooting in Jacona, Michoacán, Mexico, while six…
entries.snippet: Three civilians and two police officers are killed in a mass shooting in Jacona, Michoacán, Mexico, while six other people are wounded. Separately, three gunmen are killed in a shootout with police in Zamora.

entries.title: Twelve people, including a 2-year-old, are killed and 16 more injured during a shootout between different…
entries.snippet: Twelve people, including a 2-year-old, are killed and 16 more injured during a shootout between different factions of the Sinaloa Cartel at El Castillo Penitentiary Centre in Mazatlán, Sinaloa, Mexico. The incident is believed to have been an assassination attempt on Eduardo Jonathan Martínez Larios, a leader of Los Chapitos who was reportedly amongst the dead.
